title: ChromDecode-At: decoding Arabidopsis thaliana chromatin states from spaceflight expression data
description:
ChromDecode-At is an automatic decoder that translates Arabidopsis thaliana gene-expression changes into PCSD/AraENCODE chromatin-state language and applies it to NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) spaceflight datasets. The archive contains the complete analysis code (Python), figures (SVG/PNG), result tables (CSV), and small derived data (gene-state assignments, recovered sample metadata).

Key findings: down-regulated genes in spaceflight root and seedling RNA-seq are reproducibly enriched for the Polycomb-repressed chromatin state (odds ~3.1 in Col-0 ISS roots, ~7.0 in seedlings), the enriched module is dominated by a redox/peroxidase gene module without SOG1 promoter binding, and a power analysis shows ~9-12 replicates per group are required for a stable enrichment test (OSD-120's 6v6 design is ~10-15% powered).

Source data: NASA OSDR studies OSD-37, OSD-120, OSD-193, OSD-208, OSD-217, OSD-218, OSD-219, OSD-223, OSD-251, OSD-281, OSD-313, OSD-314, OSD-321, OSD-346, OSD-38, OSD-406, OSD-411, OSD-427, OSD-437, OSD-476, OSD-480, OSD-496, OSD-498, OSD-502, OSD-508, OSD-510, OSD-518, OSD-519, OSD-522, OSD-565, OSD-624, OSD-658, OSD-678, OSD-782; PCSD/AraENCODE chromatin states (plantchromatin.org); JASPAR 2024 PFMs; TAIR GO annotations. Source data is not redistributed.
